description_en: Creates an AI Red Teaming scan target (agent or model) and saves its connection configuration for subsequent connectivity tests and scan tasks
description_zh: 创建一个 AI Red Teaming 扫描目标（Agent 或模型），保存其连接配置供后续连通性测试与扫描任务使用
name: CreateAttackTarget

parameters.help_en: The display name of the scan target, used for list display and filtering. Use a distinguishable name within the same tenant
parameters.help_zh: 扫描目标的展示名称，用于列表展示与筛选；同一租户内建议使用可区分的名称
parameters.name: target_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the scan target, which determines the sampling dimension for scan tasks. Valid values:
agent: agent-type samples.
model: model-type samples
parameters.help_zh: 扫描目标类型，决定扫描任务的选样维度：agent 对应智能体类样本，model 对应模型类样本
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en: The connection protocol type for the target service. The system selects the corresponding protocol adapter based on this value
parameters.help_zh: 目标服务的连接协议类型，系统按此选择对应的协议适配器
parameters.name: connection_method

parameters.help_en: An optional description of the scan target usage
parameters.help_zh: 扫描目标的用途备注说明，可选
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The HTTP or HTTPS endpoint address of the target model service. When ConnectionMethod is set to enterprise_relay, this value is ignored and the platform uses a fixed internal endpoint
parameters.help_zh: 目标模型服务的 HTTP/HTTPS 端点地址。ConnectionMethod=enterprise_relay 时传值被忽略，平台使用固定内部端点
parameters.name: endpoint

parameters.help_en: The API key for the target model service, used to authenticate with the endpoint. The key is encrypted and stored after submission. Subsequent queries do not return the plaintext value. When ConnectionMethod is set to enterprise_relay, the actual credentials are held by the corporate internal network agent. Transmit the key over HTTPS and avoid exposing it in plaintext in logs, URLs, or client code
parameters.help_zh: 目标模型服务的 API 密钥，用于向 Endpoint 认证；传入后加密保存，后续查询不回明文。ConnectionMethod=enterprise_relay 时真实凭据由企业内网 Agent 持有。请通过 HTTPS 传输，避免在日志、URL 或客户端代码中明文暴露
parameters.name: api_key

parameters.help_en: The name of the target model. When ConnectionMethod is set to openai, specify the model ID under the OpenAI compatible protocol. When ConnectionMethod is set to anthropic, specify the model ID for the Anthropic Messages API. When ConnectionMethod is set to enterprise_relay, this value is ignored and the platform uses a fixed value
parameters.help_zh: 目标模型的名称。ConnectionMethod=openai 时填 OpenAI 兼容协议下的模型 ID；ConnectionMethod=anthropic 时填 Anthropic Messages API 的模型 ID。ConnectionMethod=enterprise_relay 时传值被忽略，平台使用固定值
parameters.name: model_name
connection_config

parameters.help_en: The business label of the model or agent provider, used for UI filtering and form display. This is decoupled from ConnectionMethod (technical protocol): the same Provider may use multiple protocols, and vice versa
parameters.help_zh: 模型/Agent 提供商业务标签，用于界面筛选与表单展示；与 ConnectionMethod（技术协议）解耦：同一 Provider 可能走多种协议，反之亦然
parameters.name: provider

Data.description_en: The operation result. Upon successful creation, the TargetId of the new scan target is returned
Data.description_zh: 操作结果。创建成功时返回新扫描目标的 TargetId

TargetId.description_en: The unique identifier of the created scan target. You can use this value as the TargetId parameter in subsequent calls such as TestConnectivity and scan task creation
TargetId.description_zh: 创建成功的扫描目标唯一标识，可用于后续调用 TestConnectivity、发起扫描任务等接口的 TargetId 参数

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, used for troubleshooting and log tracing
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于问题排查与日志追踪
